movelist.name: Take Down
movelist.effect: You may perform a Trip Maneuver against the target as a Free Action.

movelist.name: Guard Split
movelist.effect: The target loses 5 Defense and 5 Special Defense. If they do, the user gains 5 Damage Reduction. These effects last until the end of the scene.

movelist.name: Copycat
movelist.effect: Use the Move the target has used on their last turn. You may choose new targets for the Move. Copycat cannot miss.

movelist.name: Defense Curl
movelist.effect: The user’s Defense is raised 1 Combat Stage and they become Curled Up until the end of the Scene or they are Recalled or Take a Breather. When using the Moves Rollout or Ice Ball while Curled Up, the user gains a +10 bonus to the damage rolls of those Moves.

abilities.name: Fluffy
abilities.effect: The user resists damaging Melee attacks one step further, but resists Fire-Type attacks one step less. Defensive.

abilities.name: Rivalry
abilities.effect: Whenever the user deals direct damage to a target of the same gender, increase the Damage dealt by +5.
